note: Shown only while a feed has nothing published, and always labelled as examples written by The Cultured Human, never as something a family shared. Keep every fact checkable.

examples.title: Pitha for Bihu
examples.body: Rice cakes made at home in Assam for Bihu, above all for Magh Bihu in January. A family's version might be about who made them, which kind, and how.

examples.title: The Onam pookalam
examples.body: A carpet of flowers laid at the front of the house during Onam in Kerala. A family might share the pattern they repeat each year, or who started it.

examples.title: The painted kohbar
examples.body: In Mithila, the walls of the kohbar, the room prepared for a wedding couple, were traditionally painted by the women of the family. A family might share whose hands painted theirs.
